description.value:
You cause up to six pillars of stone to erupt from spots on the ground you can see within range, each a 5-foot-diameter cylinder rising as much as 30 feet high; the ground must be wide enough to accommodate the pillar, and you may target the ground beneath a Medium or smaller creature. Each pillar has AC 5 and 30 hit points, and crumbles into a 10-foot-radius patch of difficult terrain (requiring at least 1 minute per 5-foot section to clear by hand) when reduced to 0 hit points.

A creature standing where a pillar erupts must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be carried upward with it (a creature may choose to fail this save).

If a pillar's rise is blocked by a ceiling or other obstacle before reaching full height, a creature atop it takes 6d6 kinetic damage and becomes restrained, pinned between the pillar and the obstacle. As an action, the restrained creature may attempt a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against the power's save DC to break free, after which it must move off the pillar or fall.

Casting this power with a force slot of 7th level or higher lets you create two additional pillars for each slot level beyond 6th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 6
